Hi Samir / Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Below are concise answers to the specific items from our side, plus notes on scope and exceptions. I'll also start populating your questionnaire and share the spreadsheet back to procurement.

SOC 2
- Status: Redwood has an active SOC 2 Type II report (latest completed: 2025). We have provided a redacted copy (SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025-redacted.pdf). Full reports can be shared under NDA; let us know if procurement/legal needs the unredacted document.

HIPAA / PHI (BAA)
- BAA: Redwood will sign a BAA for Dedicated and Private deployments.
- Hosted (shared tenancy): we offer contractual protections and data isolation controls, but a BAA for hosted shared infrastructure is only available in select enterprise contracts. If Amaya needs PHI processing, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment for clear BAA coverage and isolation.

Data retention & deletion SLA (production + backups)
- Primary data (requests, responses, embeddings): default retention for hosted customers is 30 days for request traces and embeddings unless configured otherwise. Upon an explicit deletion request, Redwood will remove customer data from primary stores within 30 calendar days.
- Backups & immutable snapshots: backups are retained for disaster recovery and immutable snapshots can persist beyond primary deletion windows. Typical backup retention: up to 90 days in hosted environments. As a result, complete purging from all backup locations may take up to 90 calendar days. For Dedicated/Private we can configure shorter backup retention windows per contract.
- Exceptions: logs required for legal hold, ongoing investigations, or regulatory obligations will be retained as required and flagged; we'll coordinate with Amaya on any legal holds.

Log retention
- Application / request logs: default 90 days in hosted.
- Audit logs: 1 year by default for enterprise tiers; 13-month retention can be delivered as an add-on or via export to a customer-managed log sink (recommended for long-term retention).

Operational notes & timeline
- We'll complete Amaya's vendor security questionnaire and return the spreadsheet within 48 business hours.
- If Amaya needs guaranteed 30-day purge from backups (not just primary stores), best path is Dedicated/Private — we can include contract language and implementation timeline.
- Rishi (cc) can follow up on any contract/BAA language and next steps for procurement.

Attachments: I've attached the SOC 2 redacted report and our security overview again for your team's reference.

Next steps
1) I'll fill out the questionnaire and drop it into the Drive link Marissa provided.
2) Rishi will reach out on BAA/DPA contract language if Amaya confirms PHI processing.
3) Marissa — if you want, schedule the 30-min follow-up after we return the questionnaire.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call if any of the items above need more detail.

Regards,
